name: Oh Chung Song: falsified nationality on a freelance platform and relocation from Dubai to Vientiane

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel reporting; some claims reproduce Member State information and remain outside criminal adjudication.

caveats: The Lao People’s Democratic Republic later confirmed his arrival under an educational-cultural exchange project and in 2023 reported departures/repatriation steps, but the Panel continued seeking complete immigration records.
The United Arab Emirates response was absent at the 2022 report date.

statements: A Member State reported that Oh Chung Song used a freelance platform with a falsified nationality to supply IT programs for foreign currency; after an employer discovered the falsification in December 2021, he and associated DPRK IT workers left Dubai for Vientiane.

sources.support: Supports falsified nationality, freelance work, employer discovery and Dubai-to-Vientiane relocation
Supports Laos confirmation and the ongoing country-response caveat
Supports later departure/repatriation reporting and the Panel request for records

notes: The Korean form is newly modeled from the official source. Birth information following the quoted fragment was not retained.
